chansons.style: deep house, warm bassline, four on the floor, female smoky vocal, vocal chops, atmospheric pads, 122 BPM, dark moody club vibe
chansons.resume_fr: Une nuit où la narratrice découvre la trahison de son amant à travers des ombres et des murmures, mais danse pour oublier.
chansons.paroles:
[Intro]
(Warm bass pulses)
Shadows...
Shadows of you...

[Verse 1]
I saw your name light up at three
A whispered voice that wasn't me
The coffee cup you left behind
Still warm with lies I couldn't find
You said the city made you late
But I can read the hands of fate

[Pre-Chorus]
Every step you took away
Built a wall I couldn't break

[Chorus]
Shadows of you, shadows of you
Dancing with someone I never knew
Shadows of you, shadows of you
I'm cutting the thread, I'm cutting through

[Verse 2]
The mirror shows a stranger's eyes
A painted smile of compromise
Your jacket smells of someone else
A quiet truth I tell myself
The record spins, the needle cries
I'm done believing all your lies

[Pre-Chorus]
Every promise turned to dust
Every touch a broken trust

[Chorus]
Shadows of you, shadows of you
Dancing with someone I never knew
Shadows of you, shadows of you
I'm cutting the thread, I'm cutting through

[Bridge]
(Vocal chops echoing)
Cut the thread, cut the thread
Let the shadows fall instead
I won't chase what isn't true
I'm walking out of you

[Chorus]
Shadows of you, shadows of you
Dancing with someone I never knew
Shadows of you, shadows of you
I'm cutting the thread, I'm cutting through

[Outro]
Shadows fade...
Shadows fade...
(Fading bass)

chansons.paroles:
[Intro]

All night...
All night long...

[Verse 1]
Neon dripping on the wall
We don't hear the midnight call
Sneakers glued onto the ground
Lost inside this holy sound
Strangers turning into friends
We don't want the night to end

[Pre-Chorus]
Feel the rhythm in your chest
Throw away the need to rest

[Chorus]
Floor on fire, floor on fire
Take me higher, take me higher
Floor on fire, floor on fire
We burn until the morning light

[Verse 2]
Sweat is falling like the rain
No tomorrow, only now
Every beat a shooting star
We don't care just who we are
Hands up reaching for the sky
We were born to never die

[Pre-Chorus]
Feel the rhythm in your chest
This is where we feel the best

[Chorus]
Floor on fire, floor on fire
Take me higher, take me higher
Floor on fire, floor on fire
We burn until the morning light

[Bridge]
(Vocal chops rising)
Don't stop, don't stop
Until the sun comes up
Don't stop, don't stop
We're never going home

[Chorus]
Floor on fire, floor on fire
Take me higher, take me higher
Floor on fire, floor on fire
We burn until the morning light

[Outro]
Until the morning light...
Until the morning light...
(Soft fade)

chansons.paroles:
[Intro]
(Soft synth pads)
Tick... tick... tick...
Slipping away...

[Verse 1]
I found a picture in a frame
A summer day I can't reclaim
Your laugh was frozen, bright and young
A song we never fully sung
The calendar upon the wall
Has watched me rise and watched me fall

[Pre-Chorus]
Hold it close, it runs away
Every night becomes a day

[Chorus]
Sand through fingers, sand through fingers
Nothing stays the way it lingers
Sand through fingers, sand through fingers
Time is singing, time is singing

[Verse 2]
The coffee shop we used to know
Is now a place I walk past slow
The vinyl records on the shelf
Are echoes of my younger self
I try to grab what used to be
But it just flows right out of me

[Pre-Chorus]
Hold it close, it runs away
Every night becomes a day

[Chorus]
Sand through fingers, sand through fingers
Nothing stays the way it lingers
Sand through fingers, sand through fingers
Time is singing, time is singing

[Bridge]
(Vocal chops, slow and warm)
Let it go, let it flow
That's the only way to grow
What is gone is gone for good
But I loved it while I could

[Chorus]
Sand through fingers, sand through fingers
Nothing stays the way it lingers
Sand through fingers, sand through fingers
Time is singing, time is singing

[Outro]
Singing...
Singing...
(Fading pads)

A thousand miles of blue between
You're sipping tea, I'm drinking wine
Our fingers almost seem to twine
The pixel smile you send my way
Is keeping all my ghosts at bay

[Pre-Chorus]
Different suns, the same old moon
I will meet with you real soon

[Chorus]
Signal in the static, signal in the static
Love across the ocean, love across the static
Signal in the static, signal in the static
Hold me through the wire, hold me through the night

[Verse 2]
Your voice is breaking through the lag
A little laugh, a little drag
I trace your outline on the glass
And pray this lonely spell will pass
The clock is cruel, the morning near
But I can feel you standing here

[Pre-Chorus]
Different suns, the same old moon
I will meet with you real soon

[Chorus]
Signal in the static, signal in the static
Love across the ocean, love across the static
Signal in the static, signal in the static
Hold me through the wire, hold me through the night

(Vocal chops with delay)
Through the wire, through the wire
Burning with a quiet fire
Every byte, every beat
Makes the lonely feel complete

[Chorus]
Signal in the static, signal in the static
Love across the ocean, love across the static
Signal in the static, signal in the static
Hold me through the wire, hold me through the night

[Outro]
Through the night...
Through the night...
(Static fades)

chansons.paroles:
[Intro]
(Bright synths rising)
We're young...
We're golden...

[Verse 1]
Windows down on route nineteen
Chasing skies we've never seen
Pocket change and gasoline
Living like we're seventeen
No one asked us where we're bound
Feet don't ever touch the ground

[Pre-Chorus]
Tomorrow's just a rumor now
We don't need to ask them how

[Chorus]
Golden haze, golden haze
We could live inside these days
Golden haze, golden haze
Nothing's ever in our way

[Verse 2]
Bonfire sparks against the dark
Every stranger leaves a mark
Cheap sunglasses, candy taste
Not a single hour to waste
We swore we'd never settle down
Kings and queens of every town

[Pre-Chorus]
Tomorrow's just a rumor now
We don't need to ask them how

[Chorus]
Golden haze, golden haze
We could live inside these days
Golden haze, golden haze
Nothing's ever in our way

[Bridge]
(Vocal chops, euphoric)
Never fade, never fade
We're the mess we always made
Hold it close, hold it tight
We're the kings of summer night

[Chorus]
Golden haze, golden haze
We could live inside these days
Golden haze, golden haze
Nothing's ever in our way

[Outro]
Inside these days...
Inside these days...
(Sunrise fade)

chansons.style: deep house, gentle four on the floor, warm round bass, ambient pads, soft female vocal, healing vocal chops, 123 BPM, sunrise recovery mood
chansons.resume_fr: Après une longue blessure, la narratrice sent la lumière revenir lentement et réparer chaque fissure.
chansons.paroles:
[Intro]
(Warm pad swell)
Breathing in...
Breathing out...

[Verse 1]
I spent a winter in my chest
Afraid to try, afraid to rest
The mirror showed a hollow face
A ghost who couldn't find her place
But somewhere deep beneath the snow
A tiny seed began to grow

[Pre-Chorus]
Crack the window, let it in
Let the quiet work begin

[Chorus]
Mending light, mending light
Stitching up the endless night
Mending light, mending light
I am learning how to rise

[Verse 2]
The tea is warm, the sheets are clean
I'm painting skies I've never seen
A letter written to my past
Says I forgive you now at last
The scars are maps of where I've been
Not walls to keep the world from in

[Pre-Chorus]
Crack the window, let it in
Let the quiet work begin

[Chorus]
Mending light, mending light
Stitching up the endless night
Mending light, mending light
I am learning how to rise

[Bridge]
(Vocal chops, gentle)
Slowly now, slowly now
I don't need to figure how
Bit by bit, day by day
The broken pieces find their way

[Chorus]
Mending light, mending light
Stitching up the endless night
Mending light, mending light
I am learning how to rise

[Outro]
How to rise...
How to rise...
(Light fades in)

chansons.style: deep house, soft kick, warm vintage bass, nostalgic piano chords, gentle male vocal, subtle vocal chops, 121 BPM, heartfelt living room vibe
chansons.resume_fr: Un petit-fils contemple les photos de ses grands-parents et entend leurs voix résonner dans la maison silencieuse.
chansons.paroles:
[Intro]
(Soft piano, warm bass)
Grandma's voice...
Grandpa's hands...

[Verse 1]
The mantelpiece is lined with them
Black and white and gold and gem
Her Sunday dress, his working shirt
A quiet love that never hurt
I smell her perfume in the hall
His pipe still leaning on the wall

[Pre-Chorus]
Every frame a little door
To a world I'm longing for

[Chorus]
Silver frames, silver frames
Calling out their gentle names
Silver frames, silver frames
Love that never ever fades

[Verse 2]
He taught me how to fix a wheel
She taught me how a heart should feel
They danced on Sundays after tea
And saved a little bit for me
Their hands were worn, their eyes were bright
They held the world with quiet might

[Pre-Chorus]
Every frame a little door
To a world I'm longing for

[Chorus]
Silver frames, silver frames
Calling out their gentle names
Silver frames, silver frames
Love that never ever fades

[Bridge]
(Vocal chops, warm)
They are here, they are here
In the laughter, in the tear
In the wood, in the stone
I am never on my own

[Chorus]
Silver frames, silver frames
Calling out their gentle names
Silver frames, silver frames
Love that never ever fades

[Outro]
Never fades...
Never fades...
(Piano linger)

chansons.titre_fr: Le dernier train pour la maison
chansons.style: deep house, steady kick, deep warm bass, cinematic strings pad, emotional female vocal, echoing vocal chops, 125 BPM, bittersweet farewell mood
chansons.resume_fr: Sur un quai de gare à l'aube, deux amants se disent adieu sachant que le train les séparera pour toujours.
chansons.paroles:
[Intro]
(Distant train, deep bass)
Last train...
Last train home...

[Verse 1]
The platform lights are cold and pale
Your scarf is tangled like a tale
You check your watch, you look away
There's nothing left for us to say
The speaker calls your final ride
I swallow everything inside

[Pre-Chorus]
One more look, one more touch
I have loved you way too much

[Chorus]
Last train home, last train home
Carries you where I can't roam
Last train home, last train home
I will love you on my own

[Verse 2]
The doors are closing, slow and kind
You press your palm against the blind
I match it with my trembling hand
A language only we understand
The whistle blows, the wheels begin
The ending and the starting spin

[Pre-Chorus]
One more look, one more touch
I have loved you way too much

[Chorus]
Last train home, last train home
Carries you where I can't roam
Last train home, last train home
I will love you on my own

[Bridge]
(Vocal chops, echoing)
Go now, go now
Take the life you need somehow
I'll be fine, I'll be fine
You were always meant to shine

[Chorus]
Last train home, last train home
Carries you where I can't roam
Last train home, last train home
I will love you on my own

[Outro]
On my own...
On my own...
(Train fades)

Fly away...
Fly away...

I found a box beneath the stairs

A song my mother used to sing
The scraped up knees, the lemonade
The forts we built, the mess we made

[Pre-Chorus]
Take me back, take me back
To the place before the cracks

[Chorus]
Paper planes, paper planes
Flying through the summer rains
Paper planes, paper planes
Bring me back to who I was

[Verse 2]
The swing set rusting in the yard
The hiding place that wasn't hard
We thought the world was small and kind
A treasure we were meant to find
I'd trade my phone, my car, my name
To play one more pretending game

[Pre-Chorus]
Take me back, take me back
To the place before the cracks

[Chorus]
Paper planes, paper planes
Flying through the summer rains
Paper planes, paper planes
Bring me back to who I was

[Bridge]
(Vocal chops, light)
Fold it up, send it high
Little dreamer in the sky
Catch the wind, catch the sun
Childhood never really done

[Chorus]
Paper planes, paper planes
Flying through the summer rains
Paper planes, paper planes
Bring me back to who I was

[Outro]
Who I was...
Who I was...
(Music box fades)
